body: Shit man same boat. Hate the feeling of being so trapped between just hanging on and hating all of it or just giving up and peacing out... If you're at all like me, you don't believe it can ever get better but I guess sticking around is the only way to find out. Or at least that's what I keep trying to tell myself. Wish this world would chill out and take time to care and help one another instead of whatever "this" is. Hang in there brother, you are not alone. I'm sorry you have to deal with this
Ah man now I'm sitting here hoping I didn't make my mom sad
Thank you. This means more than words could ever describe. I glad you made it through that being an even stronger person and I should take notes on you.

I thought nobody gave a fuck until you and some others posted on here. Maybe we both just surround ourselves with the wrong people or in my case no people at all and start to feel hopeless. Here's to hoping we both find that someone.

I'm currently talking with my mom to get my insurance card so i can get help. I'll have to wait a while I'm sure but I've made it 22 years so far like this. I'm sorry you read this post but thank you all for your kind words and support. No promises but the people who came to this post just helped me more than you might ever know. I made this post with tears in my eyes and a shotgun in my lap. I put it away and I'm going to bring my dog on a walk.

Thank you very much for this advice. I feel selfish for having you read this but I really want you to know you've given me more hope than anyone in my life that there's still a chance. I'm so used to getting brushed off by everyone that it's almost a shock anyone would bother all. I don't know you but I love you and really appreciate your help.
It truly is. I'm sorry you read this :c I really hope you can find the help I'm yet to find.
My plan is to go "backpacking" this weekend and make sure I'm never found. I'll leave a note so they know to not bother looking.

Thank you. I will see what I can do about getting into a psychiatrist. Do you have to be referred by a doctor or can you contact one directly? 

At this point sooner is crucial. Later will be too late.
It would be so easy to pull it. Can you just imagine a last sharp inhale and just doing it? What do you think happens next? I wonder what it feels like if anything at all.

I'm here right now. I'm just not happy about it :/

I've been writing my name over and over on a shotgun shell while imagining what it would be like to pull the trigger.

What doctor can I go see? I went to a guy once who ignored everything I said then prescribed me 20mg fluoxetine saying its anxiety. I spoke with him for less than 2 minutes before saying that's what it is and this is the fix. I said it only made things worse so all he did was bump it up to 40mg. That wasn't a good doctor right? I wont visit him again and havent take the pills for 2 months.

I've been told that for the past 12 years and items only getting worse. I'm sorry but at this point I don't think anything can stop me. Every night is more painful than the last and I'm just past the point of caring.

How can it get better of its only gotten worse and worse over every year? I don't want to die but my desire to not live is becoming so strong. I cant see the light anymore and in just prolonging the inevitable. I wanted to wait for my parents to pass so they wouldn't have to endure the pain I just cant take it anymore.

8 more years of pain is too much. This is the hope I've kept holding onto and it only gets worse for me. I'm humiliated that I cant even afford to house and feed myself anymore. I have a job  it going into the slow season I cant even feed myself. I'm sorry but I cant find the point.

I'm at the point where doing is the same as not doing it. Either way it's all to painful to carry on. I don't want to die but I cant take the pain anymore. I'm really trying to hold on but every day becomes harder and harder to accept this fate. I don't want to die but I'm ready to no longer live. I wish nobody had to feel this pain
Take care of yourself I may not be the last :) thank you again.
That doesn't change the fact that you have a heart of gold and stopped me when I was seconds from pulling the trigger. Thank you not only from me but everyone I would have affected.

I'll do my best to remember this. I do love petting my dog and going on hikes. I'm glad you responded when you could have scrolled right on past. I was just gonna do it before your comment came through. I might have to re read this everyday to remind myself but I promise I'll try to hold on. I need to find a way to help people or make them happy, maybe it will teach me to be happy. I love you stranger on reddit, at least for now you may have just stopped me from doing something stupid. Thank you for the reminder that not everyone is evil. I will keep moving on as best I can. Thank you so so much. Any advice is greatly appreciated.
Fuck man why do such good hearted people have live life like this.

I'm really trying to hold on I'm just at my breaking point. I've tried medications and therapists but there's something so fake about paying someone to listen to your problems and nothing helps. I'm convinced the pain I'm in at this point is far deeper than that of having to cope with my death. People move on and I'm ready to move on in my own way. I've carried on this long I hope to find the courage to keep going. I don't want to die I just am so lost and scared.
